item.description: This usually happens if you are dropping the source to the server. Or if it drops on its own (which can happen). item.description: When trying to connect to your server, you receive a 10061 error and the server won’t start. This is almost always caused by the information being incorrect. item.title: Auto DJ don't start Auto DJ Problem - AMFMPH Streams Online
item.description: The auto dj comes with 5 playlists, 3 of them by default like “General Rotation”. We recommend that you disable 2 of the 3 “General Rotation”, leaving just one enabled. The autodj needs at least 1 playlist as “General Rotation” with at least 1 file in it to start. If you have more than 1 […]

item.title: How do I cancel my account? - AMFMPH Streams Online
item.description: When logged into your Client area in the menu click on: Services->My Services Click on the service you want to cancel. Click “Request Cancellation” Enter in reason Click Submit button.

item.title: How to contact our support? - AMFMPH Streams Online
item.description: Registered clients can contact our support team: Login to clients area. Select “Open Ticket” on menu. Select department you wish to contact. Fill up the form and submit. Guests can contact our support team: On Menu click on “Contact Us” Fill up the form, captcha and submit.

item.title: How to get more listeners for my station? - AMFMPH Streams Online
item.description: To get more listeners exposure, please register and submit your station to http://www.amfmph.com and you will reach web base and cellphone base listeners for free.
